"Hi Michael, the issue you’re experiencing with Outlook sounds frustrating. When emails aren’t loading in the correct order, it’s often due to sync settings or indexing problems. Before creating a new folder, try adjusting your sort settings within Outlook to ensure emails are arranged by date. Also, check your account sync preferences—limiting the time range of emails synced (e.g., only emails from the past year) can significantly reduce the load on your folder.

If this doesn’t resolve the issue, creating a new folder for your older emails and archiving them might be a good idea. This will help keep your current folder manageable and improve loading times.

On another note, if you’re managing a business and rely on email for client communications, a custom website with an integrated email management system could make things much smoother. Collaborating with a web designer Dubai can help you set up a professional and efficient platform that ensures seamless communication and boosts overall productivity. content: Ouvimos de outros usuários do Yandex que a configuração de uma senha de aplicativo foi útil. Você pode fazer isso no Yandex em Todas as configurações > Segurança > Ativar senhas de aplicativos e seguir as etapas. Esperamos que isso o ajude a acessar seu e-mail do Yandex no Thunderbird.
